title: Terms of Service for RallyGo
intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the RallyGo mobile application, website, and related services (collectively, the "Service").
The Service is operated by RallyGo ("RallyGo," "we," "us," or "our"). By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms and acknowledge our Privacy Policy.
If you do not agree to these Terms, do not access or use the Service.

sections.title: 1. About the Service
paragraphs: RallyGo helps tennis players:
bullets: Discover other players in the same city or geographic area.
Create, publish, and join tennis events or matches.
Communicate with other players through chat rooms.
Manage tennis-related profiles, invitations, and event participation.
Report inappropriate content or behavior and block other users.
footer: We provide a technology platform that helps users connect. Unless expressly stated otherwise, we do not organize, supervise, officiate, or participate in matches and are not a party to agreements or arrangements made between users.
We do not guarantee that a particular player, event, court, location, or match will be available, suitable, accurate, safe, or completed as described.

sections.title: 4. User Safety and In-Person Matches
paragraphs: Tennis events may involve meeting other users in person. You acknowledge that meeting people through an online service involves risk.
You are responsible for evaluating whether to communicate with, meet, or play with another user. When arranging a match, you should:
bullets: Meet at a recognized public tennis facility.
Tell a trusted person where you are going.
Avoid sharing sensitive personal or financial information.
Use your own judgment before accepting transportation.
Leave the location and contact local authorities if you feel unsafe.
Follow facility rules, applicable laws, and reasonable safety precautions.
footer: We do not routinely conduct criminal, identity, health, or background checks on users. We do not guarantee another user’s identity, conduct, skill level, availability, physical condition, or intentions.
Call emergency services if you believe someone is in immediate danger. In-app reporting is not an emergency-response service.

footer: Users are independently responsible for court reservations, equipment, transportation, expenses, physical readiness, and any agreement concerning match format or cost-sharing.
We may remove an event or restrict event creation if we reasonably believe it is fraudulent, misleading, unsafe, unlawful, or contrary to these Terms.
